notes.title: A new rebalance patch and game news!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been some time since we've had a chance to work on the game, but we finally decided to release a rebalance patch.

A major part of this rebalance focuses on weapons. The idea was to make ammo consumption more uniform, giving the weapons more distinct characteristics and making their progression more meaningful.

The update should already be live with this post.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26613726/cef2cd78cb7fec7be6693ac7adef30f68d05c9c0.jpg[/img]

Another thing that we would like to share with you is that we have just announced our new game - Atre: Dominance Wars which is a 4x fantasy game where you strive to become a God.

Check out the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=rjbk24HNHOs;full][/previewyoutube]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805850/Atre_Dominance_Wars/

Thank you all!
Hrvoje

notes.title: Overhaul Patch is now live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26613726/7561f44890dc3855ac48b8edf723b2b485e35689.jpg[/img]
We are proud to announce that the game is receiving a major patch that focuses on polishing up both gameplay and graphics. Check this [url=https://youtu.be/c9tzRxSzQ_E]video[/url] for a short demonstration.

Full patch notes:

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Optimized the game
[*]Connected single player and survival save games
[*]Tweaked and improved almost every level and boss fight
[*]Improved visuals in every level of the game
[*]Terminator enabled from the start
[*]Improved in-game UI
[*]Removed all skill supplies - skills now use cooldowns so you can focus on using the skills instead of gathering supplies for them!
[/list]
[b]Misc. Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Recruit difficulty is fun easy mode now
[*]Removed damage spikes in game
[*]Removed some skills that are obsolete now
[*]Holt and Ker fight made more fair
[*]Snatchers will pin you much less now
[*]Tons of bugfixes and small quality of life changes
[/list]

The patch is available now, so everyone can get to blast their favorite space baddies with the best space marine and drone around.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - New maps and huge optimization!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26613726/7561f44890dc3855ac48b8edf723b2b485e35689.jpg[/img]

Hello everbody,
we've been silent for some time but we've been working constantly!

We are presenting 2 more environments for you to play in survival.

[b]Map - Tharsis Street[/b]
Battle in one of the first singleplayers maps in survival mode, quite different map layout then on open desert.

[b]Map - Hangar[/b]
Battle to gather supplies before evacuating with your dropship, with some twists.

Both maps share similar monster spawns, and some monsters will not appear like they do in desert maps.

We also provided you with extra ammunition, by adding a chance for a monster to drop a clip when killed, thus rewarding people who like to be... thorough :)

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
We've made a huge optimization over entire game, we are also working on optimizing the game even further within next update, when this is done we will update our MINIMAL system requirements.

Thank you for being with us! :)

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
> New survival map - HANGAR!
> New survival map - STREET!

[b]OPTIMIZATION[/b]
[list]
    [*]optimized pathfind (total monsters on screen increased by 50%)
    [*]opitimized skeletal mesh rendering (total monsters on screen increased by 50%)
    [*]optimized ingame UI by 80%
    [*]optimized skill tree selection UI by 70%
    [*]optimized ENTIRE game across everything!
[/list]


[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
    [*]improved eggs in nest, slightly more challenging now
    [*]added eggs through sewers, slightly more challenging now
    [*]slightly improved some weapons
    [*]merged first three levels of singleplayer
    [*]killing monsters will drop clips sometimes 
[/list]

notes.title: Solstice Chronicles: MIA updated! More languages, less issues
notes.content:
With this update we introduce Chinese and Russian translations. 

Also included it this update are following tweaks and fixes:
[list]
[*]Second player now has different laser color
[*]Salamander does no longer show non existing clip ammo
[*]Infinite reload problems on low reload times fixed
[*]Players who completed the game can start over on level 4
[*]Added a "revert all" button that reverts all upgrade selections made in armory for a particular mission
[*]Special ammo names properly displayed when picking up the item
[*]Hide gui shortcut moved to CTRL+H
[*]Autoaim will now regenerate slowly over time
[*]KER legs staying alive after monster has been killed issue fixed
[*]SMG character buffs get applied properly
[*]Special ammo stats stack properly
[*]Special ammo meshes displayed properly
[/list]

As always, if you encounter any problems or have any suggestions please report them on the forums and we will continue working on them.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Solstice Chronicles MIA second update!
notes.content:
[img]https://fig-images.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fd3pylr1apgoxnh.cloudfront.net%2Fcampaign_body_images%2Fimages%2Fd6f20ecf40f7b2e131ca13fb3dcc7698d7184c98%2Foriginal.png%3F1489510376?ixlib=rails-2.1.4&w=570&fit=min&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=26aa6815468589580eb96d7828c99c70[/img]

Hello everyone!

With the new version we have implemented an option for coop to be played either with keyboard+mouse and a controller or with two controllers. Option is available through the gameplay options menu. Due to the way controllers are assigned, it is available only when accessing options from the main menu (can't be changed mid game).

We have also added translations for German and French. You can change the language from the gameplay options menu. At this point there might still be some errors in the translations. Please let us know if you find any.

We have also been working on improving a number of ingame skill descriptions. 

Minor gameplay fixes also include:
- Ker will not regenerate while underground
- Ker legs will be treated as burrowing units so seismic resonators can properly damage them
- Holer type creatures will no longer enter endless healing in survival


Enjoy the now even better game!

notes.title: Biggest update so far! Survival mode and FIRST stretch goal!
notes.content:
Almost funded! Let's make it great :)

We're presenting you what we personally call "TRS mode" in Solstice Chronicles: MIA.

You don't like singleplayer? Well this will be right up your alley..Enjoy :)
https://www.fig.co/campaigns/solstice-chronicles-mia

[h1]Survival Mode in details[/h1]
In addition to the story mode we already talked about, Solstice Chronicles: MIA also features a survival mode. In this update we will be explaining what survival mode is and how it differs from the story mode. Also, since we are nearly funded, we will be introducing our first stretch goal, the improved survival mode.

[h1]Survival mode features:[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Defend against endless waves for features
    [*]Overall difficulty increases over time
    [*]Explore open map and gather new equipment and skills
    [*]Upgrade character and equipment with each successful evac (EVAC appears every few min)
    [*]Manage your resources
   [*] Build your base(barricades, ammo stations, etc.)
   [*] Random supplies, enemy spawns, evacs - replayability
[/list]

[h1]Just Survive[/h1]
Basic principle behind survival mode is quite simple. Survive as long as you can against increasingly challenging odds. A survival game starts with players dropping to a randomly selected starting position, solo or in local coop with a friend. From there on, he is on his own to explore, scavenge for supplies, construct defenses or just hunker down and survive. 

[img]https://fig-images.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fd3pylr1apgoxnh.cloudfront.net%2Fcampaign_body_images%2Fimages%2Fb65d744e29532292ebdb88b4513c17d011bcd651%2Foriginal.jpg%3F1489059742?ixlib=rails-2.1.3&w=570&fit=min&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=e1b5e406a4cc168071a7b4032823609f[/img]

[h1]Manage your resources[/h1]
Resources and exploration are a even more important in survival mode. Like in story mode, resources come either in easily visible crates that can be used by players, or as resources (ammo clips, medkits, pieces of weaponry etc.) that can be found scattered randomly throughout the map or be brought to the player by the drone. As only resources resources that actually exist and are accessible can be brought, finding and unlocking new areas will be of utmost importance.

[h1]Build your base[/h1]
While exploring the map, constructible objects can also be found. Those special items represent packaged constructions like barricades, turrets etc. Drone is able to pick them up and construct at the location of player's choosing.

[h1]Upgrade character and equipment[/h1]
Third important aspect of exploration are skill and weapon unlocks. First time player drops into survival mode, he comes armed with just a pistol and basic skills unlocked for his class. During game time he will find additional weapons and skill modules scattered at random locations throughout the map that will allow him to equip those elements at the start of subsequent games.

[h1]Survival Cycles[/h1]
Survival mode is divided into cycles, lasting several minutes (may vary based upon difficulty and other factors). At the end of each cycle, player is given a choice: either try to survive longer for additional rewards or take what he earned so far and evacuate. If the player decides to evacuate, he will have to reach a randomly selected point on the map where his game ends. 

[img]https://fig-images.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fd3pylr1apgoxnh.cloudfront.net%2Fcampaign_body_images%2Fimages%2Fda94beec35a7a4e73b741ef1e71a29482c70b1c5%2Foriginal.png%3F1489079486?ixlib=rails-2.1.3&w=570&fit=min&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=6adcd2dfa12d7f275fb670c3fb42027f[/img]

Based upon his success, player is then awarded weapon and skill upgrade points and he gets to keep all the weapons and skills he has unlocked during the mission. If hedecides to stay, a number of additional supplies and upgrades get dropped, and a new cycle begins. With every cycle, monsters get tougher and more numerous,so a cycle 5 threat level 1 might be more difficult then cycle 1 threat level5. If at any point player dies, game ends and all the progress player made during that mission is lost.

As we are nearing our funding goal, it's time to start talking about stretch goals.

[h1]Improved Survival mode features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Defend against endless waves for survival
    [*]Explore open map and gather new equipment and skills
    [*]Upgrade your character and equipment with each succesfull evac
    [*] Manage your resources
    [*] Build your base(barricades, ammo stations, etc.)
    [*]Random supplies, enemy spawns, evacs - replayability
[/list]
[list]
    [*]   *NEW* select resource drop on each survival cycle
    [*]    *NEW* missions that appear randomly
    [*]    *NEW* unlock and fortify buildings
    [*]    *NEW* build special objects like „Reaper Turret“
    [*]    *NEW* more survival maps
[/list]

Find out more about this at! 
https://www.fig.co/campaigns/solstice-chronicles-mia

[img]https://fig-images.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fd3pylr1apgoxnh.cloudfront.net%2Fcampaign_body_images%2Fimages%2Fd8c716f06059f33bca9092a54bbd7ad1ab4dc6e2%2Foriginal.png%3F1489062810?ixlib=rails-2.1.3&w=570&fit=min&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=e3692cc1236873682ffde2989cf80878[/img]

We really really really, want this stretch goal, help us and let's make it happen together :)

Spread the word, tell your friends, share on forums, imgur, reddit, twitter and let's do it! 
Thank you all!

[img]https://fig-images.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fd3pylr1apgoxnh.cloudfront.net%2Fcampaign_body_images%2Fimages%2Fb65d744e29532292ebdb88b4513c17d011bcd651%2Foriginal.jpg%3F1489059742?ixlib=rails-2.1.3&w=570&fit=min&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=e1b5e406a4cc168071a7b4032823609f[/img]

[h1]Manage your resources[/h1]
Resources and exploration are a even more important in survival mode. Like in story mode, resources come either in easily visible crates that can be used by players, or as resources (ammo clips, medkits, pieces of weaponry etc.) that can be found scattered randomly throughout the map or be brought to the player by the drone. As only resources resources that actually exist and are accessible can be brought, finding and unlocking new areas will be of utmost importance.

[h1]Build your base[/h1]
While exploring the map, constructible objects can also be found. Those special items represent packaged constructions like barricades, turrets etc. Drone is able to pick them up and construct at the location of player's choosing.

[h1]Upgrade character and equipment[/h1]
Third important aspect of exploration are skill and weapon unlocks. First time player drops into survival mode, he comes armed with just a pistol and basic skills unlocked for his class. During game time he will find additional weapons and skill modules scattered at random locations throughout the map that will allow him to equip those elements at the start of subsequent games.

[h1]Survival Cycles[/h1]
Survival mode is divided into cycles, lasting several minutes (may vary based upon difficulty and other factors). At the end of each cycle, player is given a choice: either try to survive longer for additional rewards or take what he earned so far and evacuate. If the player decides to evacuate, he will have to reach a randomly selected point on the map where his game ends. 

[img]https://fig-images.imgix.net/https%3A%2F%2Fd3pylr1apgoxnh.cloudfront.net%2Fcampaign_body_images%2Fimages%2Fda94beec35a7a4e73b741ef1e71a29482c70b1c5%2Foriginal.png%3F1489079486?ixlib=rails-2.1.3&w=570&fit=min&auto=format%2Ccompress&s=6adcd2dfa12d7f275fb670c3fb42027f[/img]

Based upon his success, player is then awarded weapon and skill upgrade points and he gets to keep all the weapons and skills he has unlocked during the mission. If hedecides to stay, a number of additional supplies and upgrades get dropped, and a new cycle begins. With every cycle, monsters get tougher and more numerous,so a cycle 5 threat level 1 might be more difficult then cycle 1 threat level5. If at any point player dies, game ends and all the progress player made during that mission is lost.
